note: In-app support: conversation, history and rating, as captured in marketing/demo/captures/08-10 and video/app-support-history.mp4. Dari capture reused for Pashto. Facts checked 2026-09-24: iOS live on the App Store (Afghanistan storefront only, since 2026-09-21, app-store/metadata.md) and Android on Google Play (since 2026-08-28) — the generator prints both store names in the footer; safebeauty.web.app/get stays the one printed link and sends each phone to its own store. Salons are in Kabul only — no second city, no count. No promotion running. Every salon, name, price and time on a screen is the invented demo world from marketing/demo/ — nothing real.

fa.headline: سؤال دارید؟ از داخل اپ بپرسید
fa.body: گفتگو با پشتیبانی، تاریخچهٔ پیام‌ها و امتیازدادن — همه داخل اپ.

ps.headline: پوښتنه لرئ؟ له اپ دننه یې وپوښتئ
ps.body: له ملاتړ سره خبرې، د پیغامونو تاریخچه او ستوري ورکول — ټول په اپ کې.
